{{NSE|SANDHAR}} | founded = 1987 | founder = Jayant Davar | hq_location = [[Delhi, India]] | num_locations = India, Spain, Mexico, Poland | area_served = Worldwide | key_people = Arvind Joshi {{cite news |title=Sandhar Technologies' Arvind Joshi speaks on Q2 performance |url=https://www.timesnownews.com/videos/news/business/sandhar-technologies-arvind-joshi-speaks-on-q2-performance-earnings-with-et-now/14702 |publisher=TIMES NOW |date=12 Nov 2018}} (whole-time director, [[Chief financial officer|CFO]], [[Company secretary|CS]]) | industry = [[Manufacturing]] | products = [[Automobile]] equipment | services = Engineering | revenue = {{increase}}[[United States Dollar|US$]]430.6 million(''FY 2025'') | assets = {{increase}}[[United States Dollar|US$]]307.4 million(''FY 2025'') | equity = {{increase}}[[United States Dollar|US$]]150 million(''FY 2025'') | owner = | num_employees = 11,000+ | parent = | divisions = | subsidiaries = Sandhar Technologies Barcelona, Sandhar Tooling, Sandhar Strategic Systems Private Limited | website = {{url|sandhargroup.com}} | footnotes = Annual Report 2025 [https://sandhargroup.com/uploads/Investor/financial-results_standalone-and-consolidated_march2025.pdf] }} '''Sandhar Technologies Limited''' or '''Sandhar Group''' or '''Sandhar''' ({{IPAc-en|s|ə|n|d|h|ɑː|r|}}), is an Indian [[multinational corporation|multinational]] and a global manufacturer of automotive components. The company was founded in 1987 by Jayant Davar, currently has 3 [[subsidiaries]] and 10 [[joint venture]] with 47 factories all over the world.{{cite news |title=Company Overview of Sandhar Technologies Limited |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=25321428 |publisher=Bloomberg |date=11 December 2018}} == History == [[File:Sandhar Technologies Barcelona, S .png|thumb|Sandhar Technologies Barcelona, S. L.]] * '''1987-90:''' The company was founded in 1987 by Jayant Davar and started supplying sheet metals for [[Hero Honda]] motorcycles and received technical assistance from [[Honda Lock SC|Honda Lock]] to manufacture lock systems for the motorbikes. * '''1990-95:''' It started producing mirrors and door handles for [[Honda]] cars thanks to technical assistance received from Honda Lock and even up to the date it is the only supplier for Honda cars.{{cite news |last1=Dhingra |first1=Mayank |title=Sandhar Technologies locks in on Honda cars |url=http://www.autocarpro.in/feature/sandhar-technologies-locks-honda-cars-29564 |publisher=AUTOCAR PROFESSIONAL |date=19 May 2018}} * '''2000-05:''' The company starts investing in Zn, Al die casting and tools and dies. * '''2006-10:''' Enters in the field of wheel assembly production such as handle bar, spools for seatbelt retractors and PDC products. * '''2011-16:''' The business expanded to manufacture plastic injection moulding seatbelts then eventually set up a research unit [[Gurugram]]. * '''2016-18:''' Thanks to joint venture with Whetron and Jinyoung,{{cite news |title=Sandhar Tech aims 50% revenue from auto electronic; launching IPO early next month |url=https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/auto-components/sandhar-tech-aims-50-revenue-from-auto-electronic-launches-ipo-early-next-month/62885062}} the company has started to manufacture automotive electronic products. In December 2017 the company entered into joint venture with Daeshin Machinery Ind. Co. Ltd. By the end of 2018, the company announced a joint venture with Kwangsung Corporation Ltd., [[Korea|Rep Korea]] to manufacture [[sunvisor]], cargo screen, black-Out tape, glove box & several other blow-moulded products. * '''2019:''' The company has entered into Joint Venture with Winnercom Co. Ltd.,{{cite news |title=Sandhar Technologies forms JV with Winnercom |url=https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/auto-components/sandhar-technologies-forms-jv-with-winnercom/69853001}} and Hanshin Corporation of [[Korea|Rep Korea]],{{cite news |title=Sandhar Technologies ltd signs JV agreement with Han Shin Corporation |url=https://www.equitybulls.com/admin/news2006/news_det.asp?id=253887}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Portal|Companies}} [[Category:Indian Engineering Services]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1987]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]

Sandhar Technologies Limited or Sandhar Group or Sandhar (), is an Indian multinational and a global manufacturer of automotive components. 
The company was founded in 1987 by Jayant Davar, currently has 3 subsidiaries and 10 joint venture with 47 factories all over the world.
